integrity: The proof is analytic. Its only non-elementary input is the published Mellin diagonalization of the Carleman operator; no numerical experiment is used as an infinite-dimensional certificate.
limitations: The theorem proves the directed two-parameter eigenvalue limit but not the separate fixed-K Fourier-symbol maximization identity or an explicit convergence rate.
title: Carleman compression resolves the Haar-wavelet near-Tsirelson eigenvalue conjecture
